description: Track the moving dice with the gripper. Clamp each while its top face is level and the seal ring is full. The captured top faces must add to the displayed target. Dice keep moving while the gripper is held. A bad clamp or incomplete certification ends the attempt.
name: Top-Face Dice Arithmetic V2 · Difficulty 5 · Full Interaction
